note: Norfolk Island is an external Territory of Australia, and the Australian Citizenship Act counts the external Territories as Australia (s. 3), so its people are Australian citizens and Australia's rules on naturalisation and on keeping citizenship are theirs.

sources.title: Federal Register of Legislation, Australian Citizenship Act 2007 (compilation of 4 June 2026), section 3 (Definitions)
sources.said: Australia, when used in a geographical sense, includes the external Territories.
